plugins.name: sanctuary-framework
plugins.description: The open source standard for secure, private AI: operating-system enforcement is live on macOS today, and the Ubuntu 24.04 x86-64 fresh-install per-account signed-policy claim is proven with current portability bounds called out in the Assurance Matrix; Windows is roadmap. Wraps any MCP-compatible agent with encrypted state, approval gates, a portable identity and reputation, and an audit tool that finds security and privacy gaps in your current setup.
